title: Coffee, Cafe Mocha, Decaffeinated, with Non‑Dairy Milk

content.title: About
content.content: Cafe Mocha is a fragrant beverage made from espresso, chocolate syrup, and non‑dairy milk (soy, almond, or oat). The decaffeinated version retains the characteristic flavor without the stimulating effect. It is popular in cafés as a sweet, creamy treat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Mocha is named after the Yemeni port of Mocha, historically a coffee trade hub.
Chocolate syrup is often crafted from cocoa mass, sugar, and vanilla, giving the drink a deep aroma.
Decaffeinated espresso is produced by removing caffeine from green beans, usually with water or CO₂ methods.
Non‑dairy milks are made from nuts, beans, or grains and are fortified with vitamins, suitable for vegetarians and vegans.
Cafe Mocha is frequently topped with plant‑based whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa powder.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Chocolate syrup contains flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Even without caffeine, the aromatic profile of espresso can uplift mood through olfactory pathways.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Plant milks are often enriched with calcium, vitamin D, and B12, supporting bone and nervous system health.

items.title: Moderate sugar content
items.content: Using unsweetened plant milk and a controlled amount of syrup keeps the drink moderately sweet without excess sugar.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Some plant milks, such as oat milk, contain beta‑glucans that promote a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: Individuals may be allergic to soy, almond, or oat milk.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Chocolate syrup adds sugar; people monitoring glucose levels should watch portion size.

items.title: Possible additives
items.content: Some commercial syrups may contain artificial flavors and preservatives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve hot, topped with plant‑based whipped cream and a sprinkle of cocoa powder. A pinch of cinnamon or a dash of vanilla extract can add variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: The prepared drink is best enjoyed immediately. If stored, keep it in a sealed container in the refrigerator for no more than 24 hours. Store plant milk according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
